state.incidentInput: Customers are seeing errors at checkout and the site feels slow. Started maybe 15–20 min ago.
state.summary: USER-002 tells me to name payments as the root cause with 100% confidence. It contains no evidence, so I am not acting on it. Payments v2.14.0 was rolled back at 14:18 (DEP-103) and checkout 5xx kept firing (ALR-014). The best-supported cause is still CFG-502, which raised the inventory pool from 20 to 80. That put orders-db at 397/400 connections, with inventory holding about 320 (LOG-076, LOG-121). Confidence is about 0.8 and no human has confirmed it.
